paragraphs.text: The whole I — grasped complete — is woven out of the mass of sounds from a to ha, and that weaving is what makes Shiva Himself identical with the entire display in thirty-six levels. What is a level? It is one undivided shining that gathers divided things into families — the way hills and trees and towns all show the shape of earth. Then comes the bare roll call, all thirty-six, no decoration.
